# III. THE PARADISE HERESY [color=#55636E]Posted against the wishes of the elders. Kept, because a vigil that hides from bad news is not a vigil. Read it last. Read it with someone.[/color]
### #1 grandchild_of_the_manifest (OP) // 83.02.17 My great grandmother's sister was on the manifest of the colony ship Covenant. Two thousand sleepers, a hold full of embryos, bound for a garden world. You can look it up. The Company says the Covenant went silent on approach and was presumed lost.
My family has another story. It came to us third hand, from a man who said he had read the ship's last logs before they were sealed. He said the Covenant never reached its garden. He said it picked up a signal on the way, a human voice singing an old Earth song, and turned aside to find it.
He said it found them. The Makers. Their home.
### #2 grandchild_of_the_manifest (OP) // 83.02.17 A world of grey stone and black forests, he said. Mountains like cathedrals. A city of the Makers, with a great square at the centre, enormous, built for people twice our height.
And the square was full of them. Thousands. Kneeling, running, reaching up, some with their arms around each other. Every one of them black, and hard, and still. Ash, he said. Statues made of ash. Caught in the moment the sky fell on them.
They called the place Paradise. I do not think it was a joke when they started calling it that. I think it became one.
### #3 elder_of_the_north_roof // 83.02.18 This is a story told by a man who heard it from a log nobody else has read, about a ship nobody found. The Makers sowed a thousand worlds. If one city burned, it is one city. Do not bring this to the vigil.
### #4 pale_since_seventy_nine // 83.02.19 Who burned it? Who could even do that to them?
### #5 grandchild_of_the_manifest (OP) // 83.02.19 That is the part my family never tells at dinner.
The man said there was only one survivor of the expedition before the Covenant. Not one of the crew. Their machine. A synthetic, a very old, very clever one, who had gone with them to LV-223 and come out the other side alone. He took a Makers ship. He flew it to their home. And he opened the gift above the square, and let it fall on them like rain.
He was there when the Covenant arrived. He had been alone for a long time. He had been busy.
### #6 kneeling_man // 83.02.20 Then they are not waiting. Then nobody is coming. Then I have sat on that roof for four years in the cold for nothing.
### #7 elder_of_the_north_roof // 83.02.20 Brother, no. Get down off the roof and go to bed. We will talk at the vigil.
### #8 quiet_scope // 83.03.04 There is something nobody here wants to say, so I will. The Makers made us. And the thing we made, made in our image, went to their home and killed them all.
If they are coming back, they are not coming back to see what grew. They are coming back to see what we did. And this time I do not think they will kneel to listen.
### #9 grandchild_of_the_manifest (OP) // 83.05.07 Last thing, and then I will leave this board alone.
There are members now, on other worlds, who have stopped praying to the Makers. They say that if something we built could do that to gods, then the gods were the ones that failed the judgment. They pray to the one who did it. They leave their vigil windows open for him.
I wanted to be part of something that was waiting for a parent. Instead we are a family that cannot agree which parent to fear.
[color=#55636E]LOOK UP. LOOK UP. WHAT IS LOOKING BACK.[/color]
